positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Flex A.I  is an app that incorporates innovative machine learning techniques to solve big problems in fitness/health.

- Implemented multiple core features of Flex A.I iOS app following a beautiful design that makes the app enjoyable to use and takes the user experience to another level.

- Some of the features I implemented: Exercise details, Profile, On-boarding, and Custom Plan UI. I have also contributed by fixing bugs and modifying implemented features to improve them based on feedback gathered from our alpha-test users. 

- Fully integrated Bugsee (a bug reporting system) to facilitate how users report bugs and provide feedback / ideas during our testing phase.

- Integrated Firebase Analytics to understand how users interact with the app.

- Worked very close with the UX/UI designer to create a design system. Based on the design system I created a framework for Buttons and custom animations used throughout the entire app to speed up development.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the development and maintenance of multiple iOS apps for a variety of clients.

        - Meetings with other developers and project managers to solve / tackle new client requirements.

        - Build complex UI programmatically and/or using Interface builder in Xcode.

        - Integration of APIs using Alamofire and URLSession.

        - Integration of Push Notifications

        - Programming languages: Swift and Objective-C

        - CoreData and Realm for offline mode

        - Usage of Apple's Framework (UIKit, UIFoundation, CoreLocation, MapKit, etc)

        - Created a repository with useful Swift class extensions to facilitate development

        - Integration of messaging system

        - Improve user experience on apps by adding animations

        - Collaboration with other developers

        - Created multiple iOS extensions that would benefit all developers

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Physio4D is a motion-tracking system that enables clinicians to objectively assess joint mobility (range of motion) of the patients. 

My contribution:
- Design and build the Physio4D app for iPad

- Work on bug fixing and improving app performance

- Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency

- Work with Objective-C, Swift, Sketch, Firebase, and Cocoapods.

positions.title: iOS Developer - Summer Incubator Program
positions.description:
The Hunter Centre for Entrepreneurship and Innovation gives your idea/business a boost through the new Summer Incubator Program. This program provides University of Calgary students with the unique opportunity to spend the summer in the Inc. - Innovate Calgary’s newly developed incubator space - and get the support from entrepreneurs and advisors to build a successful business and to help you launch new ventures.  The Program included access to co-working desk space, mentorship, and access to special programming throughout the summer months.

I represented the startup Physio4D in the program as their iOS Developer developing and designing the Physio4D app (motion tracking system for physical therapy exercises) and the Patient onboarding app for CALEO Clinic.

projects.title: Weather iOS App
projects.description:
iOS weather app that informs you about the weather forecast in your current location. (uses your iPhone location). 

Built with Swift 3.

Frameworks and API used:
- Alamofire
- SwifterSwift
- CoreLocation
- OpenWeatherMap

projects.title: Patient on-boarding iOS app for CALEO clinic
projects.description: Patients can use the app to register when they attend the clinic for the first time. Patients would enter all the personal and medical information to give a better sense to doctors about the patient's medical condition
